counterfactual.change: Increased wall 0 width from ~0.255 to 1.0 (same position/height); thicker wall removes the missed thin-corner to side transition and no violation occurs in 16 steps.

explanation: Fast large body (r~1.15, speed~48) first touches the bottom-left corner of the thin wall (w~0.255) at step 15 (distance -0.10, below wall bottom y~2.54). No wall impulse is applied: vx stays 37.06 from step 15 to 16. The corner contact is missed/mis-resolved, so the body continues to step 16 where it is vertically aligned with the wall side and deeply embedded (overlap 1.08). Likely cause is corner-vs-face handling for thin boxes failing to generate a repulsive impulse/positional correction.
vision_note: The red ball moves leftward low near the floor toward the bottom tip of the thin vertical wall on the right. In step 16 it ends up directly under and overlapping the wall's lower end instead of bouncing off.
